behaviors.description: Identify the controlled sandbox's application process and supervising parent.
behaviors.preconditions: DO_NOT_REAP launches held alive until explicit release; public procfs exposes process executable and ancestry.
behaviors.expected: Child PID becomes positive and executable bytes match the deployed probe; process ancestry reaches outer PID; child watch confirms successful exit.

behaviors.preconditions: CLI launches independent runtime probe and reports instance ID; probe confirms execution before inspection.
behaviors.expected: Exactly that live instance reports NULL app, expected runtime and runtime commit; sandbox is explicitly killed and reaped.

mappings.rationale: Synchronized child PID must identify the deployed probe executable; its ancestry must reach the outer PID; caller child watch confirms exit.
Synchronized actual runtime sandbox selected by launch-reported instance ID has NULL application getter.
